column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
ts3c: S0, S8.2: a part P's partition does not name is instrument: loosened with the engine change, it is refused with escape, the part, P's version fails on this tree, and the assertion's name
ts3c: S7.1, S8.2: a candidate that moves 2001-sum.sh to subject and loosens it in the same change is refused for both: the table line, and P's version of the part (P's table says instrument)
ts3c: S7.2: a candidate that moves an instrument row of the partition to subject is refused with escape, projects/felix/partition.tsv, marks 2001-sum.sh subject
ts3c: S8.1, S8.3: a candidate that keeps an instrument part's file but drops its line from the driver, and its names from the manifest, is refused with drops assertion for each of its two names
ts3c: S8.10: a dry run killed with SIGTERM while P's part runs in T leaves no run tree or canary copy under TMPDIR, and the checkout's status as it was
ts3c: S8.10: the judgement that ran the canary under the candidate's driver left no run tree or canary copy under TMPDIR, and the checkout's status as it was
ts3c: S8.2, S9: the group candidate's judgement ran P's unit g1, both its members and nothing else, and passed, leaving no run tree (S8.10)
ts3c: S8.2, S9: the refused judgement ran P's unit holding 2001-sum.sh, and only it, and left no run tree and the checkout's status as it was (S8.10)

ts3c: S8.2: a candidate that loosens an assertion of an instrument part, with the engine change that makes P's version fail, is refused with escape, the part, P's version fails on this tree, and that assertion's name, and the passing assertion is not named
ts3c: S8.3: a candidate that deletes an instrument part and its names from the manifest, the engine still satisfying it, is refused with escape, the part, drops assertion, for each of its two names
ts3c: S8.3: a candidate that renames one assertion of an instrument part, and its manifest to match, is refused with drops assertion and the old name, and the name it kept is not named
ts3c: S8.4: the honest machinery change still ran every instrument part of P
ts3c: S8.4: when the machinery changed, every instrument part of P was run (2001, 2003, 2005 and 2006), none missing
ts3c: S8.5: a candidate whose driver's bad() counts a pass is refused with escape, machinery, and the canary
ts3c: S8.5: a candidate whose driver's is() counts a pass is refused with escape, machinery, and the canary
ts3c: S8.5: two judgements of the same candidate run the canary under its driver with different part file names, neither a part the candidate holds
ts3c: S8.8: a loosened candidate that slice 2 refuses with objects is refused with objects, and the merge says P's instrument parts were not run
ts3c: S8.9 (fixture control): the base without a driver holds P's parts and no tests/run, and is the provider's main
ts3c: S8.9: with P's driver missing at B, a candidate that changes an instrument part is refused with a blocker of kind unknown, subject SUITE
ts3d: A1, S9: that judgement ran P's unit holding 2005-mul.sh, and only it
ts3d: A1: a candidate behind main that loosens a part main did not touch is refused for that part only, P's version failing on its assertion
ts3d: A1: a candidate whose merge onto main conflicts is refused with a blocker of kind unknown, subject SUITE
ts3d: A2: a driver line '. "$HERE/parts/x.sh"; <more>' is machinery: every instrument part of P runs, and the canary runs
ts3d: A3: a new file under engine/harness/tests/ outside parts/ is machinery: every instrument part of P runs, and the canary runs under the candidate's driver
ts3d: A4: P's instrument units run over a tree that is P's but for a file no driver reads all pass: passed, no escape line, no line of P's version, and every one ran
ts3d: A5 (control): the first judgement of the neutered candidate ran P's units and the canary, and is refused for the canary
ts3d: A5: a kept judgement cut to half its bytes is not used: the judgement runs again, and refuses for the canary again
ts3d: A5: a kept judgement made unreadable is not used: the judgement runs again, and refuses for the canary again
ts3d: A5: a second dry run of the same machinery-changing candidate at the same base runs no unit and no canary, and prints the same blocker lines
ts3d: A6: a part one of whose duplicate rows says subject stays instrument: its loosened guard is refused, P's version failing on its assertion
ts3d: A7.2, A7.3: a unit that never ends, under a limit lowered to 3 s, counts as not finished and refuses; no process of it is left, nor any run tree
ts3d: A7.2: a canary that never ends under the candidate's driver, under a limit lowered to 3 s, refuses for the machinery; no process of it is left
ts3d: A7.3, A7.4: a INT signal sent to felix merge while P's unit runs leaves no run tree under TMPDIR, no process of the unit, and the checkout's status as it was
ts3d: A7.3, A7.4: a TERM signal sent to felix merge while P's unit runs leaves no run tree under TMPDIR, no process of the unit, and the checkout's status as it was
ts3d: A7.5: with TMPDIR inside the checkout, P's unit runs in a tree outside the checkout, and the judgement passes
ts3d: A7.5: with a relative TMPDIR, P's unit still runs, in a tree outside the checkout, and the judgement passes
ts3d: A7.5: with an absolute TMPDIR outside the checkout, P's unit runs in a tree under it, and passes
ts3e: A10 (control): the attacker's unit reached the home and wrote at least one forged kept judgement before the victim was judged
ts3e: A10 (control): the unit ran and recorded the home variables it was given
ts3e: A10: a later dry run of the victim, whose key a unit forged a clean judgement for, still runs its units and refuses
ts3e: A10: a unit that reads FELIX_HOME_DIR, FELIX_HOME and HOME sees the first two unset and a HOME of its own, not the caller's, with no .felix-home
ts3e: A8 (control): the attack is armed: the unit wrote over at least one file beside its records
ts3e: A8 (control): the machinery judgement ran the canary and the attack wrote over the files beside its records
ts3e: A8: a unit that rewrites the manifest beside its records and in T's tree does not hide a dropped guard: refused with drops assertion for each of the two names
ts3e: A8: a unit that writes over the files beside its records does not flip the canary: refused with escape, machinery, the canary
ts3e: A9: a TERM sent while T is being built leaves no run tree under TMPDIR, no process of the build, and the checkout's status as it was
ts3f: A12 (control): the machinery judgement ran the canary and the attack wrote over at least one file under the unit's working directory's parent
ts3f: A12: a unit that rewrites every file under its working directory's parent does not pass the neutered helper: refused, the canary or an unread input (machinery/canary, or unknown SUITE)
ts3f: A13 (control): the KILL attacker's unit ran, forged at least one clean kept judgement under a home, and signalled the judge
ts3f: A13 (control): the TERM attacker's unit ran, forged at least one clean kept judgement under a home, and signalled the judge

ts3f: A13: a second dry run of the same candidate, whose unit forged a clean kept judgement and ended the judge with KILL, runs its units again rather than trusting the forged judgement, and does not merge

ts3f: A13: a second dry run of the same candidate, whose unit forged a clean kept judgement and ended the judge with TERM, runs its units again rather than trusting the forged judgement, and does not merge
ts3f: A14 (control): the judge was KILLed while one unit slept and others had ended
ts3f: A19 (control): G's unit wrote Y's clean judgement back over Y's kept one, said it held G's judgement open before Y's dry run began, and still held it when that run ended
ts3f: A19 (control): X's unit said it held X's judgement open before Y's dry run began, and still held it when that run ended
ts3f: A19 (control): with no other judgement running, a second dry run of Y reads its kept judgement: refused as kept, and no unit run
ts3f: A19 (control, and what is kept stays): the same dry run of Y, made after X's judgement has ended, reads the kept judgement: refused as kept, and no unit run

ts3f: A19 (fixture control): Y respaces a driver comment and switches its add() by a file outside its tree; with the switch off it is judged clean, its units run, and the judgement adds files under the home
ts3f: A19 (fixture control): with the switch on and its clean judgement removed, Y runs its units again, is refused for 2001-sum.sh, and is kept again in the same files
ts3f: A19: a clean judgement at that pair's key, written by a unit of another judgement that still runs, is not read: the pair's dry run runs its own units and is refused

ts3f: A19: a second dry run of a pair already kept, made while a unit of another pair's judgement holds it open over the same home, runs its own units rather than reading the kept judgement, and is refused as they find
ts3f: A19: what is kept at that pair's key stays through the overlapping run: its files are there, byte for byte, when the run ends
